name: OSPD Provenance Profile (RSS-Hydro implementation)
abstract: Constrained, domain-agnostic profile of the OGC PROV building block for describing the processing steps of a geospatial workflow. One of the parallel OSPD 2026 Activity 1 implementations. Restricts provenance records to a flat, identifier-linked graph and requires each processing activity to declare its process type, its temporal extent and its responsible agent.
